verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs show registrable HTTPS webhook endpoints that receive real-time events. Event destinations extend delivery to EventBridge and Azure Event Grid with snapshot or thin event formats, and Workbench can listen for webhook events. That covers the core outbound-callback capability for keeping a system in sync with payment state, but the pack never documents signed deliveries, automatic webhook retries, delivery/event logs, or replay. (Smart Retries applies to failed payments, not webhook delivery, so it earns no credit here.) Missing for 10: webhook signature verification, automatic delivery retries, event/delivery logs, event replay/resend, independent corroboration.
